instruction.name: vmulwev.q.d
instruction.description: Multiply the even-positioned signed 64-bit elements in `a` and the corresponding signed 64-bit elements in `b`, extending both to 128-bit, and save the 128-bit result in `dst`.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500.
